Temporary Employment Services (TES) Digital Communications Specialist 3

Temporary Employment Services (TES) Employees perform a variety of general clerical and administrative support functions for multiple departments during the course of employment. One of our departments on the Davis Campus is looking for a temporary Digital Communications Specialist 3 / Videographer/Photographer for a temporary assignment.

Temporary Assignments may involve activities such as creating documents and spreadsheets using MS Office and other similar tools, calendar management using Outlook, scheduling meetings both in person and virtual, event planning, making travel arrangements, processing expense reports, processing payroll transactions, human resources support, and other related clerical duties such as reception, answering phones, filing, scanning and managing correspondence.
(11:59pm 9/29/26); Interviews and recruiting process may occur at any time
Experience creating engaging multimedia stories using a variety of media sources and footage including: video, audio and graphics.
Expertise in producing, editing and publishing videos and photos for a variety of digital platforms.
Experience taking photos for college website, press releases, college events and print and digital publications.
Experience with coordinating photo shoots with faculty and staff.
Experience using graphics software and tools to edit digital video and photos.
Keep collections current, archive multimedia files and digital images, and ensure that metadata information is complete and correct.
Ability to turn topics (research, students, field work, community impact) into interesting videos, photos, and simple graphics that make sense to non-experts.
Experience with shooting and editing videos from start to finish
Experience with Adobe Premiere
Comfortable interviewing faculty and explaining research clearly and effectively.
Flexibility, willingness to accept Temporary Assignments regardless of classification and/or pay rate.
Temporary Employment Services assigns jobs throughout UC Davis Campus (Davis) and UC Davis Health (Sacramento) encompassing a wide variety of work environments.
Assignments can last from anywhere, from a month to two years depending on the position and the need of the department.
Employees are expected to remain flexible when accepting temporary assignments as job duties and pay rates will vary.
May be required to work occasional overtime, evenings, and/or weekends depending upon the assignment.
Positions require a background check and may require a pre-placement medical exam.
Must complete mandatory training within 15 days from start date of first assignment. In addition, those assigned at UCDHS must complete the HIPAA Privacy and Security Training prior to placement.

UC Davis is a smoke and tobacco free campus. Smoking, the use of smokeless tobacco products, and the use of unregulated nicotine products (e-cigarettes) will be strictly prohibited on any UC Davis owned or leased property, indoors and outdoors, including parking lots and residential space
The ability to learn quickly and multi-task.
Interpersonal, verbal and written skills to interact and communicate effectively with a wide variety of people.
